title: VisibilityProposal
description: A proposed topology workbench change compiled or authored against a visibility session.

sessionId.description: Visibility session this proposal belongs to.

requestText.description: Original user request or concise UI action summary that produced the proposal.

summary.description: Concise summary suitable for proposal banners and chat responses.

expectedBindingHash.description: Binding hash the proposal expects to apply against.

basedOnRevision.description: Session revision this proposal was created against.

patch.description: Overlay patch represented by this proposal.

affectedLayerIds.description: Stable layer ids affected by the proposal when known.
